subject: Are you okay?
body:
Sweetheart, I heard about the layoffs on the news. Are you alright? Are you eating? Your father says hi (he didn't). Write back when you can.

Love, Mom

outcomes.when: the player replies warmly and reassures mom
outcomes.reply: Oh good. I was worried. Call me on the weekend.

outcomes.when: the player asks mom for money
outcomes.reply: I knew it. I sent you a little something. Don't tell your father. Buy vegetables.

hints: She just wants to know you're alright.
